title: Grateful Dead Live at Recreation Hall, UC Davis on 1982-03-14
lineage: Master Cassettes (Nakamichi Dragon) > Pro Tools 12 > .wav 24/96 > Adobe Audition 2022 > TLH2496

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard transfer praised as a blessing for the archive, despite added minute‑plus silences on “Sugaree” and “Althea”.
ai_review.review: The reviewer gives the recording five stars, lauding the new CM mastering as a major improvement to the archival source. The only criticism is an unexpected minute of dead air inserted into Sugaree and Althea, but overall the soundboard capture is described as clear and highly valued.

ai_rating.rationale: A single enthusiastic five‑star review highlights excellent recording quality with only minor silence issues, leading to a high overall rating despite limited data.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear and well‑balanced soundboard capture; however, an added minute‑plus of dead air on Sugaree and Althea is noted by the reviewer.
